BC_description: The getSelector function in attribution-related modules now sorts class names alphabetically in the generated selector string to reduce cardinality. This changes the order of class names in selectors, which may affect downstream code that relies on a specific order for matching or other purposes.
Adaptation_method: Review and update any code that depends on the specific order of class names in selectors generated by getSelector. For example, if you previously expected a non-sorted order, ensure your code does not hardcode the order. Instead, use the selector as provided or implement custom sorting if necessary. Code example: Before: const selector = getSelector(element); // Might have classes in original order. After: const selector = getSelector(element); // Classes are now sorted alphabetically; adjust any logic that assumed a different order.
